articles.title: Maharashtra civic polls: Eknath Shinde fears BJP; god willing, we’ll have our mayor, says Uddhav Thackeray
articles.summary: Ahead of Maharashtra civic polls, former Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray expressed confidence that his faction would secure the Mumbai mayoral post. He also claimed that current CM Eknath Shinde feared the BJP, highlighting the intense political rivalry. The statement underscores ongoing power struggles and shifting alliances within Maharashtra's political landscape concerning local body elections.

articles.title: In first R-Day after Operation Sindoor, on display: How battle formations move

The parade will feature the newly-raised Bhairav light commando battalion and a diverse array of indigenous defence platforms, underscoring India's growing self-reliance and strategic strength. This showcase aims to project national might and advancements in military technology.

articles.title: Maharashtra civic polls: Eknath Shinde corrals his 29 corporators in hotel; no question of poaching, says CM Devendra Fadnavis
articles.summary: Ahead of Maharashtra civic polls, Eknath Shinde has reportedly gathered 29 corporators in a hotel, a move often seen as a strategy to prevent defection or secure support. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, however, denied any poaching attempts. This incident highlights the intense political maneuvering and strategic efforts by parties to consolidate their positions and ensure electoral success in the run-up to crucial local elections in the state.
